Class TurretSubsystem

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.TurretSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public class TurretSubsystem extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
A subsystem that allows control of the flywheel, the hood, the turret's angle, and the kicker.

    • homeHood

      public edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command homeHood()
      Returns a Command that homes the hood by slowly driving it toward the lower hard stop and zeroing the encoder when a current-based stall is detected.

      The hood is a NEO 550 on a SparkMax with a 301:1 effective gear ratio (16:1 gearbox driving a 16-tooth pinion on a 301-tooth ring gear). The command drives the motor at HOOD_HOMING_SPEED (a small open-loop output toward the lower mechanical stop) until the SparkMax output current exceeds HOOD_HOMING_STALL_AMPS for at least HOOD_HOMING_STALL_DURATION_S continuous seconds. It then zeros the built-in relative encoder and sets hoodLimitSet = true, unlocking normal closed-loop angle control.

      The NEO 550 free-run current is roughly 1 A; stall is roughly 8 A. The default threshold of 4 A sits comfortably in between and will trip well before the motor reaches its thermal stall point at the slow homing speed.

      Returns:
      the homing command

    • setSystemsCheckMode

      public void setSystemsCheckMode(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables systems-check mode. While enabled, periodic() will not apply the trajectory-tracking overrides (hood/turret angle targeting, idle flywheel spin-up), giving the systems-check commands exclusive control of the mechanism.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enter systems-check mode, false to resume normal operation

    • isTargetingHub

      public boolean isTargetingHub()
      Returns true when the turret is currently targeting either alliance hub. Used to gate shooting during inactive hub periods — if the hub is not active and the turret is aimed at it, shooting should be blocked.

    • kick

      public void kick(double strength)
      Runs the kicker motor only when the flywheel is within Constants.TurretSubsystemConstants.FLYWHEEL_READY_TOLERANCE_RPS of its target speed AND the coprocessor has a valid trajectory. Stops the kicker otherwise so a game piece is never fed into an under-speed flywheel.
      Parameters:
      strength - The strength to run the motor at, on a scale of -1 (full reverse) to 1 (full forward).
